snippet.title: Time Collage: Focus Puzzle | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Time Collage: Focus Puzzle on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4581900/Time_Collage_Focus_Puzzle/

Watch the focus tools, puzzle journeys, postcards and statistics in action.

An ADHD-friendly, low-distraction focus and productivity game built around instant feedback. When distraction or procrastination makes starting hard, this quiet desktop buddy keeps you company through Pomodoro study and work sessions, with to-dos, white noise and puzzle rewards.

Turn moments of focus into puzzle pieces. Complete cozy picture-book scenes, watch them come to life, and collect postcards from each journey.

Windows & macOS (Apple Silicon) · 28 languages
By ZhiYan Studio · 拾光拼途

Explore the game on itch.io:
https://zhiyanstudio.itch.io/time-collage-focus-puzzle

#TimeCollage #Pomodoro #CozyGames
